Not an object capability sandbox. Caller access to Function/eval/constructor remains general object-bridge capability, unsupported for dynamic execution by minigame platform; no comprehensive filtering claimed.
Proxy callback exception cleanup lacks finally in official implementation; retained as a documented negative control.
Non-Uint8Array buffer views copy the whole backing buffer; SharedArrayBuffer-backed views are not specially rejected. Caller must constrain owned ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array.
